findings.description: The new stub states "this stub keeps the old path and its anchors stable", but it retains only the H1 heading. Every H2 anchor from the original file is gone: #skill-loading-priority, #license-validation-flow, #exit-codes, #environment-variables, #version-control-automatic-gitignore, #security-considerations, #troubleshooting, and the rest. The implementation report says anchor preservation was done only for recommended-hooks §4 and the session-continuity notes-guard recipes, so for this file the stub's own text overstates what it preserves.
findings.failure_mode: Any inbound link of the form constructs-integration.md#exit-codes (or any other H2 fragment) now resolves to the stub with no matching heading, so the fragment silently lands at the top of a four-line file. A reader or agent following such a link gets no content and no indication the section moved. The stub's wording also misleads future maintainers into believing fragment links are safe.
findings.suggested_fix: Either (a) amend the stub text to say only the path is stable and anchors have moved, or (b) keep the original H2 headings in the stub as one-line pointers to the reference file so fragments still resolve. In both cases grep the repo for 'constructs-integration.md#' and repoint any fragment links to .claude/protocols/reference/constructs-integration.md#<anchor>.
